scope: Additive Dark Crown L1-27 Minion Prince passive ally-defeat threshold and stacking audit.
game_version: Official June 2025 permanent Equipment release and August 2026 return; November 2025 TH18 Equipment HP balance; dated secondary claimed client build 18.600.3; pinned raw commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba.

sources.title: Dark Days Medal Event!
facts: Dark Crown is Minion Prince Equipment that boosts his health and power a total of three times when friendly troops are defeated.
sources.limitations: The announcement does not give housing thresholds, eligibility, HP semantics, per-level percentages or tick ordering. The medal event window does not make the Equipment temporary.

sources.title: The Awesome Medal Event is here!
facts: Dark Crown was offered again as Minion Prince Epic Equipment in August 2026.
sources.limitations: The later event says nothing about effect values or execution.

sources.title: TOWN HALL 18 Crash Lands! - Update
facts: All Minion Prince Equipment gained an additional 500 HP in the TH18 balance.
sources.limitations: The statement does not define whether passive max-HP increases heal current HP.

sources.title: Dark Deal Event
facts: The three boosts occur after 60, 120 and 180 housing space of friendly troops die.
Zero-housing units, Siege Machines, cloned troops, enemy troops and Minion Prince himself do not count.
sources.limitations: No current threshold recheck, treatment of other Heroes, Pets, summoned child troops, simultaneous deaths, Revive or total versus incremental HP formula is published.

sources.title: Dark Crown — Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.version: Client build 18.600.3 as claimed by source
facts: The dated L1-27 Prince HP 550-1200 and ore-cost table matches the pinned raw record.
The page describes three boosts when allies are defeated.
sources.limitations: The public table omits per-level effect percentages, thresholds and interaction timing.

sources.title: Pinned Dark Crown Home Village Hero Equipment record
facts: The pinned payload gives all 27 Prince HP bonuses, maxHealthIncrease, maxDamageIncrease and attackSpeedIncrease fields.
sources.limitations: It does not define whether max values are per stack or totals, how health fills, when stage changes commit, or current effect continuity.

observations.note: June 2025 report only; the current 2026 trigger contract and all other eligible classes are not fully resolved.
Field names and values are preserved verbatim; percent unit and per-stage interpretation need separate evidence.

derivations.result: Retain all pinned fields and current Prince HP rows as data-only
derivations.method: Compare immutable raw HP/costs with the dated client table; leave effect fields historical.

derivations.result: Record official three-stage friendly-troop defeat trigger and dated historical thresholds
derivations.method: Separate Supercell's three boosts from the dated secondary 60/120/180 housing interpretation; do not implement incomplete eligible-unit and HP semantics.

rejected_inferences.rule: Count all friendly entity deaths toward a 60/120/180 threshold
rejected_inferences.reason: The release report excludes zero-housing, clones, Siege Machines and Prince; Heroes, Pets and spawned units need exact treatment.

rejected_inferences.rule: Give 30 percent HP and damage on each of three triggers at L27
rejected_inferences.reason: The raw max fields do not say whether values are per-stage or total maxima.

rejected_inferences.rule: Heal current HP by the newly added maximum HP
rejected_inferences.reason: No checked source defines current-HP adjustment, cap, damage ordering or defeat prevention.

rejected_inferences.rule: Apply stage changes immediately between same-tick death events by entity ID
rejected_inferences.reason: Counting and activation phase relative to attacks, traps and other deaths is unknown.

rejected_inferences.rule: Include temporary Debt Collector troops from the release event
rejected_inferences.reason: Temporary event content is outside the goal and cannot establish permanent eligibility rules.

items: current 60/120/180 thresholds and eligible death housing classes
Heroes, Pets, summoned children, revived or cloned units and zero-housing units
whether maxHealthIncrease and maxDamageIncrease are percentages, per-stage values or totals
current HP change and survival on each maximum-HP increase
damage, attack-speed, other Equipment, Rage and Pet stacking
simultaneous death and stage-transition tick ordering
defender Banner use, Viewer stage overlay, snapshot, replay and RL state access

conclusion: Dark Crown L1-27 remains partial and catalogue-only. Official sources establish three ally-defeat boosts, and dated release reporting gives historical housing thresholds; current eligibility, HP semantics and event ordering remain unresolved.
